source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: D5 UT2: engine = PathProxy.getBoundingRect, Path.getBoundingRect with a stroke, setLocalTransform + updateTransform, sortPaths, on what real elements answer; charts = steps of setOption (the first at T0; a next one after the previous ran out, T + 10000, or `after` ms into it; notMerge unless `merge`), recorded at the last T + samples. Each element: an item path of a new series (id s<series>/<dataIndex>/<path>) or another path of its view (s<series>/x/<k>); morph[i] = __morphT >= 0 and not combining, d[i] the replaced buildPath's PathProxy data (codes M1 L2 C3); comb[i] = __isCombineMorphing, pieces = its childrenRef() in order (present, morph, d, style); style = the effective fill / stroke / lineWidth / opacity, snap = the path's transform and shape keys, g.* its Symbol group's -- a key the same at every sample written once. Every number is the hex of its double; a digest case writes a path as fnv<count>:<FNV-1a 32 of the hexes joined by ",">.
